if type(GGM) == "table" and type(GGM.shutdown) == "function" then pcall(GGM.shutdown, true, true) end
GGM = { version = "1.3.0", schema = 1, ui = {}, handlers = {}, timers = {}, invites = {}, invite_serial = 0, group = nil, self_name = nil, connected = true, last_update = 0, actual_mode = "detailed", drag = { active = false }, visible_layout = {}, last_hp_band = {}, last_alert_at = {}, }
GGM.defaults = { schema = 1, x = "70%", y = "2%", width = "29%", height = "62%", visible = true, font_size = 9, mode = "auto", show_self = true, show_hp = true, show_mana = true, show_moves = true, show_quest = true, show_tnl = true, room_filter = "all", snapshot_names = {}, hidden_members = {}, manual_order = {}, sort_mode = "server", quest_last = false, room_first = false, gauge_style = "gradient", number_style = "both", overlay_numbers = true, legacy_shortcuts = true, debug_enabled = false, invite_ttl = 900, colors = { background = "#101216", panel = "#181b21", panel_remote = "#121419", border = "#4a4f59", text = "#e6e6e6", muted = "#8b9099", health = "#28b463", health_dark = "#145a32", mana = "#3498db", mana_dark = "#174a6e", moves = "#20c7c9", moves_dark = "#145c5d", evil = "#ff5c5c", good = "#64d8ff", neutral = "#e6e6e6", invite = "#24466d", }, thresholds = { { enabled = true, percent = 40, color = "#f0a500" }, { enabled = true, percent = 20, color = "#e53935" }, }, alert_enabled = false, alert_cooldown = 15, alert_sound = "", }
local function trim(s) return tostring(s or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
local unpack_fn = table.unpack or unpack
local function lower(s) return trim(s):lower() end
local function clamp(n, lo, hi) n = tonumber(n) or lo if n < lo then return lo end if n > hi then return hi end return n end
local function bool_value(value, current) value = lower(value) if value == "on" or value == "yes" or value == "true" or value == "1" then return true end if value == "off" or value == "no" or value == "false" or value == "0" then return false end if value == "toggle" or value == "" then return not current end return nil end
local function deep_copy(value) if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end local out = {} for k, v in pairs(value) do out[deep_copy(k)] = deep_copy(v) end return out end
local function merge_defaults(target, defaults) if type(target) ~= "table" then target = {} end for k, v in pairs(defaults) do if target[k] == nil then target[k] = deep_copy(v) elseif type(v) == "table" then if type(target[k]) == "table" then target[k] = merge_defaults(target[k], v) else target[k] = deep_copy(v) end end end return target end
local function valid_hex(value) value = trim(value) if value:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return value:lower() end if value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return "#" .. value:lower() end return nil end
local friendly_colors = { black="#000000", white="#ffffff", gray="#808080", grey="#808080", lightgray="#d3d3d3", lightgrey="#d3d3d3", darkgray="#404040", darkgrey="#404040", red="#e53935", darkred="#800000", lightred="#ff6666", firebrick="#b22222", tomato="#ff6347", coral="#ff7f50", brown="#a52a2a", tan="#d2b48c", green="#28b463", darkgreen="#145a32", lightgreen="#66ff66", forestgreen="#228b22", lime="#7fff00", limegreen="#32cd32", seagreen="#2e8b57", springgreen="#00ff7f", blue="#3498db", darkblue="#174a6e", lightblue="#64b5f6", navy="#000080", steelblue="#4682b4", skyblue="#87ceeb", royalblue="#4169e1", cyan="#20c7c9", darkcyan="#008080", lightcyan="#66ffff", teal="#008080", turquoise="#40e0d0", yellow="#f1c40f", lightyellow="#ffffe0", orange="#f39c12", darkorange="#ff8c00", gold="#ffd700", purple="#9b59b6", mediumpurple="#9370db", magenta="#e056fd", violet="#ee82ee", pink="#ff69b4", deeppink="#ff1493", }
local aard_colors = { ["@r"]="#800000", ["@R"]="#ff5555", ["@g"]="#008000", ["@G"]="#55ff55", ["@b"]="#000080", ["@B"]="#5555ff", ["@c"]="#008080", ["@C"]="#55ffff", ["@m"]="#800080", ["@M"]="#ff55ff", ["@y"]="#808000", ["@Y"]="#ffff55", ["@w"]="#c0c0c0", ["@W"]="#ffffff", ["@D"]="#808080", }
local function resolve_color(value) value = trim(value) local direct = valid_hex(value) if direct then return direct end if aard_colors[value] then return aard_colors[value] end local key = lower(value):gsub("[%s_%-]", "") if friendly_colors[key] then return friendly_colors[key] end if Geyser and Geyser.Color and type(Geyser.Color.parse) == "function" then local ok, red, green, blue = pcall(Geyser.Color.parse, value) if ok and tonumber(red) and tonumber(green) and tonumber(blue) then return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", math.floor(clamp(red, 0, 255)), math.floor(clamp(green, 0, 255)), math.floor(clamp(blue, 0, 255))) end end return nil end
local color_list_groups = { { "Reds and warm colors", { "red", "dark_red", "light_red", "firebrick", "tomato", "coral", "orange", "dark_orange", "gold", "yellow", "light_yellow" } }, { "Greens", { "green", "dark_green", "light_green", "forest_green", "lime", "lime_green", "sea_green", "spring_green" } }, { "Blues and cyans", { "blue", "dark_blue", "light_blue", "navy", "steel_blue", "sky_blue", "royal_blue", "cyan", "dark_cyan", "light_cyan", "teal", "turquoise" } }, { "Purples and pinks", { "purple", "medium_purple", "magenta", "violet", "pink", "deep_pink" } }, { "Neutrals", { "white", "light_gray", "gray", "dark_gray", "black", "brown", "tan" } }, }
local function html_escape(value) local text = tostring(value or "") text = text:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">") text = text:gsub('"', """):gsub("'", "'") return text end
local function strip_aard_colors(value) local text = tostring(value or "") text = text:gsub("\27%[[0-9;]*[mK]", "") text = text:gsub("@x%d%d%d", ""):gsub("@z%d%d%d", "") text = text:gsub("@@", "\1") text = text:gsub("@[A-Za-z]", "") text = text:gsub("\1", "@") return text end
local function number(value, fallback) local n = tonumber(value) if n == nil then return fallback or 0 end return n end
local function format_number(value) local n = number(value, 0) local absn = math.abs(n) if absn < 100000 then return string.format("%.0f", n) end local amount, unit if absn < 1000000 then amount, unit = n / 1000, "k" elseif absn < 1000000000 then amount, unit = n / 1000000, "m" elseif absn < 1000000000000 then amount, unit = n / 1000000000, "b" else amount, unit = n / 1000000000000, "t" end if math.abs(amount) < 10 then return string.format("%.1f%s", amount, unit) end return string.format("%.0f%s", amount, unit) end
local function truncate(text, maximum) text = tostring(text or "") maximum = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(maximum) or #text)) if #text <= maximum then return text end if maximum <= 2 then return text:sub(1, maximum) end return text:sub(1, maximum - 1) .. "…" end
local function persistence_dir() local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." local dir = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end return dir end
GGM.state_file = persistence_dir() .. "/g_group_monitor_state.lua" GGM.state_json_file = persistence_dir() .. "/g_group_monitor_state.json"
function GGM.print(message, color) local text = tostring(message or "") if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<%s>[GGM] <reset>%s\n", color or "cyan", text)) elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo("[GGM] " .. text .. "\n") end end
function GGM.print_color_list() GGM.print("Available color names (each name is shown in that color):") if type(decho) ~= "function" then for _, group in ipairs(color_list_groups) do GGM.print(" " .. table.concat(group[2], ", ")) end GGM.print("Aardwolf @ colors and #RRGGBB values are also accepted. See: gmon help colors") return end
for _, group in ipairs(color_list_groups) do for index, name in ipairs(group[2]) do local color = resolve_color(name) or "#ffffff" local red = tonumber(color:sub(2, 3), 16) or 255 local green = tonumber(color:sub(4, 5), 16) or 255 local blue = tonumber(color:sub(6, 7), 16) or 255 local prefix = name == "black" and "<0,0,0:210,210,210>" or string.format("<%d,%d,%d:0,0,0>", red, green, blue) decho(prefix .. string.format("%-16s", name)) if index % 4 == 0 or index == #group[2] then echo("\n") else echo(" ") end end end GGM.print("Use one with: gmon color hp dark_green") GGM.print("Aardwolf @ colors and #RRGGBB values are also accepted. See: gmon help colors") end
function GGM.debug(message) if GGM.state and GGM.state.debug_enabled then GGM.print("DEBUG: " .. tostring(message), "yellow") end end
function GGM.load_state() GGM.state = {} local loaded = false if type(table.load) == "function" then local loaded_into = {} local ok, loaded_a, loaded_b = pcall(table.load, GGM.state_file, loaded_into) if ok then if next(loaded_into) ~= nil then GGM.state, loaded = loaded_into, true elseif type(loaded_a) == "table" then GGM.state, loaded = loaded_a, true elseif loaded_a == true and type(loaded_b) == "table" then GGM.state, loaded = loaded_b, true end end end if not loaded and type(yajl) == "table" and type(yajl.to_value) == "function" then local file = io.open(GGM.state_json_file, "r") if file then local raw = file:read("*a") file:close() local ok, loaded = pcall(yajl.to_value, raw) if ok and type(loaded) == "table" then GGM.state = loaded end end end GGM.state = merge_defaults(GGM.state, GGM.defaults) for _, key in ipairs({ "visible", "show_self", "show_hp", "show_mana", "show_moves", "show_quest", "show_tnl", "quest_last", "room_first", "overlay_numbers", "legacy_shortcuts", "debug_enabled", "alert_enabled", }) do if type(GGM.state[key]) ~= "boolean" then GGM.state[key] = GGM.defaults[key] end end if not ({ auto=true, detailed=true, compact=true, epic=true })[GGM.state.mode] then GGM.state.mode = "auto" end if not ({ server=true, manual=true, hppct=true, missing=true, name=true, level=true })[GGM.state.sort_mode] then GGM.state.sort_mode = "server" end if not ({ all=true, same=true, snapshot=true })[GGM.state.room_filter] then GGM.state.room_filter = "all" end if not ({ none=true, flat=true, gradient=true })[GGM.state.gauge_style] then GGM.state.gauge_style = "gradient" end if not ({ current=true, currentmax=true, percent=true, both=true })[GGM.state.number_style] then GGM.state.number_style = "both" end GGM.state.font_size = clamp(GGM.state.font_size, 7, 24) GGM.state.invite_ttl = clamp(GGM.state.invite_ttl, 30, 3600) GGM.state.alert_cooldown = clamp(GGM.state.alert_cooldown, 1, 300) for key, default_color in pairs(GGM.defaults.colors) do GGM.state.colors[key] = valid_hex(GGM.state.colors[key]) or default_color end for _, threshold in ipairs(GGM.state.thresholds) do threshold.percent = clamp(threshold.percent, 1, 100) threshold.color = valid_hex(threshold.color) or "#e53935" end end
function GGM.capture_geometry() local c = GGM.ui and GGM.ui.container if not c then return end if type(c.get_x) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(c.get_x, c); if ok and v ~= nil then GGM.state.x = v end end if type(c.get_y) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(c.get_y, c); if ok and v ~= nil then GGM.state.y = v end end if type(c.get_width) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(c.get_width, c); if ok and v ~= nil then GGM.state.width = v end end if type(c.get_height) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(c.get_height, c); if ok and v ~= nil then GGM.state.height = v end end end
function GGM.save_state() if not GGM.state then return false end GGM.capture_geometry() if type(table.save) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(table.save, GGM.state_file, GGM.state) if ok and result ~= false then GGM.state_dirty = false; GGM.last_save_ok = true; return true end end if type(yajl) == "table" and type(yajl.to_string) == "function" then local ok, payload = pcall(yajl.to_string, GGM.state) if ok and payload then local file = io.open(GGM.state_json_file, "w") if file then file:write(payload); file:close(); GGM.state_dirty = false; GGM.last_save_ok = true; return true end end end GGM.last_save_ok = false return false end
function GGM.schedule_save(delay) GGM.state_dirty = true if GGM.timers.save then return end if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then GGM.save_state(); return end GGM.timers.save = tempTimer(delay or 0.75, function() GGM.timers.save = nil if GGM.state_dirty then GGM.save_state() end end) end
local function kill_timer(id) if id and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, id) end end
local function destroy_object(object) if not object then return end if type(object.hide) == "function" then pcall(object.hide, object) end if type(object.delete) == "function" then pcall(object.delete, object) end end
function GGM.destroy_ui() if not GGM.ui then return end for _, row in ipairs(GGM.ui.members or {}) do for _, object in pairs(row) do destroy_object(object) end end for _, row in ipairs(GGM.ui.invites or {}) do for _, object in pairs(row) do destroy_object(object) end end destroy_object(GGM.ui.empty) destroy_object(GGM.ui.subheader) destroy_object(GGM.ui.header) destroy_object(GGM.ui.container) GGM.ui = {} end
function GGM.shutdown(save, destroy) if save and GGM.state then pcall(GGM.save_state) end for _, id in pairs(GGM.handlers or {}) do if id and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, id) end end for _, id in pairs(GGM.timers or {}) do kill_timer(id) end for _, invite in ipairs(GGM.invites or {}) do kill_timer(invite.timer) end GGM.handlers = {} GGM.timers = {} if destroy then GGM.destroy_ui() elseif GGM.ui and GGM.ui.container and type(GGM.ui.container.hide) == "function" then pcall(GGM.ui.container.hide, GGM.ui.container) end end
local function label_style(background, border, color, extra) return string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; color: %s; padding: 1px; font-size: %dpt; %s", background or "transparent", border or "transparent", color or "#ffffff", tonumber(GGM.state and GGM.state.font_size) or 9, extra or "" ) end

local function move_resize(object, x, y, width, height) if not object then return end if type(object.move) == "function" then pcall(object.move, object, x, y) end if type(object.resize) == "function" then pcall(object.resize, object, math.max(1, width), math.max(1, height)) end end

Check the Mudlet error console and profile folder permissions.", "red") end return end if cmd == "front" then GGM.bring_to_front(); return end if cmd == "back" then GGM.send_to_back(); return end if cmd == "invites" then GGM.list_invites(); return end if cmd == "debug on" then GGM.state.debug_enabled=true; GGM.apply_state_change("Debug enabled."); return end if cmd == "debug off" then GGM.state.debug_enabled=false; GGM.apply_state_change("Debug disabled."); return end
local value = raw:match("^%s*[Mm][Oo][Dd][Ee]%s+(.+)$") if value then value = lower(value) if value == "cycle" then GGM.cycle_mode(); return end if ({auto=true,detailed=true,compact=true,epic=true})[value] then GGM.state.mode=value; GGM.apply_state_change("Layout mode: "..value); return end end
value = raw:match("^%s*[Ss][Ee][Ll][Ff]%s+(.+)$") if value then local result = bool_value(value, GGM.state.show_self) if result ~= nil then GGM.state.show_self=result; GGM.apply_state_change("Show self: "..(result and "on" or "off")); return end end
value = raw:match("^%s*[Rr][Oo][Oo][Mm]%s+(.+)$") if value then value = lower(value) if value == "snapshot" then GGM.snapshot_room(); return end if value == "toggle" then value = GGM.state.room_filter == "same" and "all" or "same" end if value == "all" or value == "same" then GGM.state.room_filter=value; GGM.apply_state_change("Room filter: "..value); return end end
local action, member_query = raw:match("^%s*[Mm][Ee][Mm][Bb][Ee][Rr]%s+(%S+)%s+(.+)$") if action and member_query then action = lower(action) if action == "show" or action == "hide" then GGM.member_visibility(action, member_query); return end end
local sort_name, sort_value = raw:match("^%s*[Ss][Oo][Rr][Tt]%s+(%S+)%s*(.*)$") if sort_name then sort_name, sort_value = lower(sort_name), lower(sort_value) if ({server=true,manual=true,hppct=true,missing=true,name=true,level=true})[sort_name] and sort_value == "" then GGM.state.sort_mode=sort_name; GGM.apply_state_change("Sort mode: "..sort_name); return end if sort_name == "questlast" or sort_name == "roomfirst" then local key = sort_name == "questlast" and "quest_last" or "room_first" local result = bool_value(sort_value, GGM.state[key]) if result ~= nil then GGM.state[key]=result; GGM.apply_state_change(sort_name..": "..(result and "on" or "off")); return end end end
if cmd == "order list" then GGM.list_order(); return end local position, query = raw:match("^%s*[Oo][Rr][Dd][Ee][Rr]%s+[Ss][Ee][Tt]%s+(%d+)%s+(.+)$") if position then GGM.move_order(query, tonumber(position)); return end query = raw:match("^%s*[Oo][Rr][Dd][Ee][Rr]%s+[Tt][Oo][Pp]%s+(.+)$") if query then GGM.move_order(query, 1); return end query = raw:match("^%s*[Oo][Rr][Dd][Ee][Rr]%s+[Bb][Oo][Tt][Tt][Oo][Mm]%s+(.+)$") if query then GGM.move_order(query, #(GGM.order_names())); return end
local bar, switch = raw:match("^%s*[Bb][Aa][Rr]%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*$") if bar then bar, switch = lower(bar), lower(switch) local keys = { hp="show_hp", health="show_hp", mana="show_mana", mn="show_mana", moves="show_moves", mv="show_moves" } local key = keys[bar] if key then local result=bool_value(switch,GGM.state[key]); if result~=nil then GGM.state[key]=result; GGM.apply_state_change(bar.." bar: "..(result and "on" or "off")); return end end end
local simple, simple_value = raw:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*$") if simple then simple, simple_value = lower(simple), lower(simple_value) if simple == "quest" or simple == "tnl" or simple == "overlay" or simple == "alert" or simple == "shortcuts" then local key = ({quest="show_quest",tnl="show_tnl",overlay="overlay_numbers",alert="alert_enabled",shortcuts="legacy_shortcuts"})[simple] local result = bool_value(simple_value, GGM.state[key]) if result ~= nil then GGM.state[key]=result; GGM.apply_state_change(simple..": "..(result and "on" or "off")); return end end if simple == "gauge" and ({none=true,flat=true,gradient=true})[simple_value] then GGM.state.gauge_style=simple_value; GGM.apply_state_change("Gauge style: "..simple_value); return end if simple == "numbers" and ({current=true,currentmax=true,percent=true,both=true})[simple_value] then GGM.state.number_style=simple_value; GGM.apply_state_change("Number style: "..simple_value); return end if simple == "font" and tonumber(simple_value) then GGM.state.font_size=clamp(simple_value,7,24); GGM.apply_state_change("Font size: "..GGM.state.font_size); return end end
local color_key, color_value = raw:match("^%s*[Cc][Oo][Ll][Oo][Rr]%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*$") if color_key then local key_map = { hp="health", health="health", hp2="health_dark", healthdark="health_dark", mana="mana", mana2="mana_dark", manadark="mana_dark", moves="moves", moves2="moves_dark", movesdark="moves_dark", evil="evil", good="good" } local key, color = key_map[lower(color_key)], resolve_color(color_value) if key and color then GGM.state.colors[key]=color; GGM.apply_state_change(key.." color: "..color); return end if not key then GGM.print("Unknown color target. Use hp, hp2, mana, mana2, moves, moves2, evil, or good.", "red") else GGM.print("Unknown color '"..color_value.."'. Try green, orange, @G, or #28b463. See: gmon help colors", "red") end return end
local threshold_index, threshold_arg, threshold_color = raw:match("^%s*[Tt][Hh][Rr][Ee][Ss][Hh][Oo][Ll][Dd]%s+([12])%s+(%S+)%s*(%S*)%s*$") if threshold_index then local threshold = GGM.state.thresholds[tonumber(threshold_index)] local switch_value = lower(threshold_arg) if switch_value == "on" or switch_value == "off" then threshold.enabled = switch_value == "on" GGM.apply_state_change("Threshold "..threshold_index..": "..switch_value); return end local pct_text = (threshold_arg or ""):gsub("%%", "") local pct = tonumber(pct_text) local color = threshold_color ~= "" and resolve_color(threshold_color) or threshold.color if pct and pct >= 1 and pct <= 100 and color then threshold.percent, threshold.color, threshold.enabled = math.floor(pct), color, true GGM.apply_state_change(string.format("Threshold %s: %d%% %s", threshold_index, threshold.percent, threshold.color)); return end if pct and threshold_color ~= "" and not color then GGM.print("Unknown threshold color '"..threshold_color.."'. Try red, orange, @R, or #e53935.", "red"); return end end
local invite_action, invite_ref = raw:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+(.+)$") if invite_action then invite_action = lower(invite_action) if invite_action == "accept" then GGM.accept_invite(tonumber(invite_ref) or trim(invite_ref)); return end if invite_action == "decline" then GGM.decline_invite(tonumber(invite_ref) or trim(invite_ref)); return end end
local cooldown = raw:match("^%s*[Aa][Ll][Ee][Rr][Tt]%s+[Cc][Oo][Oo][Ll][Dd][Oo][Ww][Nn]%s+(%d+)%s*$") if cooldown then GGM.state.alert_cooldown=clamp(cooldown,1,300); GGM.apply_state_change("Alert cooldown: "..GGM.state.alert_cooldown.."s"); return end local sound = raw:match("^%s*[Aa][Ll][Ee][Rr][Tt]%s+[Ss][Oo][Uu][Nn][Dd]%s+(.+)$") if sound then GGM.state.alert_sound=lower(sound)=="off" and "" or trim(sound); GGM.apply_state_change(GGM.state.alert_sound=="" and "Alert sound disabled." or "Alert sound set."); return end
local reset = raw:match("^%s*[Rr][Ee][Ss][Ee][Tt]%s+(%S+)%s*$") if reset then reset = lower(reset) if reset == "layout" then for _, key in ipairs({"x","y","width","height","visible","font_size","mode"}) do GGM.state[key]=deep_copy(GGM.defaults[key]) end GGM.apply_geometry(); GGM.apply_state_change("Layout reset."); return elseif reset == "filters" then for _, key in ipairs({"show_self","room_filter","snapshot_names","hidden_members","sort_mode","quest_last","room_first","manual_order"}) do GGM.state[key]=deep_copy(GGM.defaults[key]) end GGM.apply_state_change("Filters and ordering reset."); return elseif reset == "settings" then for _, key in ipairs({"show_hp","show_mana","show_moves","show_quest","show_tnl","gauge_style","number_style","overlay_numbers","legacy_shortcuts","debug_enabled","colors","thresholds","alert_enabled","alert_cooldown","alert_sound"}) do GGM.state[key]=deep_copy(GGM.defaults[key]) end GGM.apply_state_change("Visual settings reset."); return elseif reset == "all" then GGM.state=deep_copy(GGM.defaults); GGM.apply_geometry(); GGM.apply_state_change("All settings reset."); return end end
GGM.print("Unknown or incomplete command. Use: gmon help", "red") end
function GGM.register_handlers() if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return end GGM.handlers.group_lower = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.group", "GGM.on_group_gmcp") GGM.handlers.group_upper = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Group", "GGM.on_group_gmcp") GGM.handlers.char_base_lower = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.char.base", "GGM.on_char_gmcp") GGM.handlers.char_base_upper = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Base", "GGM.on_char_gmcp") GGM.handlers.connect = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "GGM.on_connect") GGM.handlers.disconnect = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDisconnectionEvent", "GGM.on_disconnect") GGM.handlers.protocol = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysProtocolEnabled", "GGM.on_protocol_enabled") GGM.handlers.resize = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysWindowResizeEvent", "GGM.on_resize") GGM.handlers.reposition = registerAnonymousEventHandler("AdjustableContainerRepositionFinish", "GGM.on_container_reposition_finish") GGM.handlers.exit = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysExitEvent", "GGM.save_state") end
function GGM.init() GGM.load_state() GGM.self_name = GGM.current_self_name() GGM.ensure_ui() GGM.apply_visibility(true) GGM.register_handlers() GGM.enable_group_gmcp() local raw = gmcp and (gmcp.group or gmcp.Group) if type(raw) == "table" then GGM.group=GGM.normalize_group(raw); if GGM.group then GGM.last_update=os.time(); GGM.evaluate_alerts(GGM.group) end end GGM.schedule_render() GGM.stale_tick() end
